import pandas as pd
import matplotlib.pyplot as plt
import seaborn as sns

# Load the dataset
df = pd.read_csv('data/customer_segments.csv')

# Convert Dt_Customer to datetime format
df['Dt_Customer'] = pd.to_datetime(df['Dt_Customer'], format='%d-%m-%Y')

# Create a new column for total spending
df['Total_Spending'] = df[['MntWines', 'MntFruits', 'MntMeatProducts', 'MntFishProducts', 'MntSweetProducts', 'MntGoldProds']].sum(axis=1)

# Plot: Average total spending by education level
plt.figure(figsize=(12, 6))
sns.barplot(data=df, x='Education', y='Total_Spending', ci=None, palette='viridis', estimator=sum)
plt.title('Total Spending by Education Level')
plt.xlabel('Education Level')
plt.ylabel('Total Spending')
plt.xticks(rotation=45)
plt.grid(axis='y')

# Save the plot
plt.savefig('output.png', bbox_inches='tight', dpi=150)

import pandas as pd
import matplotlib.pyplot as plt
import seaborn as sns

# Load the dataset
df = pd.read_csv('data/customer_segments.csv')

# Convert Dt_Customer to datetime format
df['Dt_Customer'] = pd.to_datetime(df['Dt_Customer'], format='%d-%m-%Y')

# Create a new column for total spending
df['Total_Spending'] = df[['MntWines', 'MntFruits', 'MntMeatProducts', 'MntFishProducts', 'MntSweetProducts', 'MntGoldProds']].sum(axis=1)

# Plot: Average total spending by education level
plt.figure(figsize=(12, 6))
sns.barplot(data=df, x='Education', y='Total_Spending', ci=None, palette='viridis', estimator=sum)
plt.title('Total Spending by Education Level')
plt.xlabel('Education Level')
plt.ylabel('Total Spending')
plt.xticks(rotation=45)
plt.grid(axis='y')

# Save the plot
plt.savefig('output.png', bbox_inches='tight', dpi=150)
